Market today: Tech is still the main driver, but the leveraged ETFs are getting hammered. Your concentrated tech/chip book on margin means these drops are amplified.

Your holdings: SOXL (-36.59%) and SPAL (-24.14%) are the big red flags needing attention. They're marked SELL for a reason.

Watch: Keep an eye on SMCI and SNOW, as they're holding steady despite the sector weakness.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and protecting your capital.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming exposure given the SELL status and significant loss.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate reducing position size due to SELL status and drawdown.
SNOW: If it breaks below its stop of 284, consider cutting losses.
